unit.why: A short memorate: the narrator and his father stand before R. Zvi, who puts a hand on each of them while telling how the disciples once soared in the upper worlds while their masters lived.

stories.start_quote: עו״ש שסיפר מורינו הנ"ל שפ"א הי׳
stories.summary_en: R. Zvi tells the narrator and his father that while their holy masters lived, the disciples would put hands on each other's shoulders and fly in the upper worlds, but now they are afraid. Since the death of his master of Lublin he feels the difference even in his dreams.

tags.why: Recalled ascent to the upper worlds
Upper worlds as the place of the recalled ascent
Now they are afraid to ascend

quotes: שסיפר מורינו הנ"ל שפ"א הי׳ הוא
tags.why: Framed as a tale told by the named teacher
Relations between disciples and their masters (Zvi; Lublin) are the theme
The narrator's holy father is present
